race.comment: CAMDEN COVE (1) has switched from the Bjorn Baker stable to Wayne Hudd. Last raced four weeks ago over this distance at Orange where he came from last on the corner to be beaten just 1.5 lengths. Suited by the long straight and small field so this looks a lovely set-up. DARTANU (3) is a D'Argento gelding on debut for the Bateup stable which boasts a good strike rate at this circuit. Won his only trial in impressive style. Should be highly competitive in this modest maiden. Kerry Parker's Russian Revolution filly FORCE OF NATURE (8) lines up for the first time. Trial form just fair so let the betting tell the tale. CAT'S EYE (5) is another newcomer who should be monitored in the marketplace. SETTA'S GIRL (7) was mediocre on debut at Gundagai but might improve with the blinkers going on.
